entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: Command your companion to attack the source of your target's vision, even if they have no eyes. Applies Eye Injury, reducing your target's Hit Chance by 15% and applying a DoT for 6 seconds.
entries.evidence: Go for the Eyes Rank Needed: 1 Mana Cost: 15 Mana Cooldown: 4 Seconds Type: Physical Range: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target. Description: Command your companion to attack the source of your target's vision, even if they have no eyes. Applies Eye Injury, reducing your target's Hit Chance by 15% and applying a DoT for 6 seconds. Follow Up: Applies Eye Gouge, reducing your target's Hit Chance by 25% and applying a stronger DoT for 6 seconds. Note: Previously called "GO FOR THE EYES".

entries.target: A short range skill that heals yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Command your companion to cast a protective ward. Heals you and applies Borrowed Wings, increasing your Dodge by 20% for 6 seconds.
notes: Pet cannot be summoned in PVP if it's not summoned before entering Arenas.
entries.evidence: Borrowed Wings Rank Needed: 2 Mana Cost: 20 Mana Cooldown: 8 Seconds Type: Physical Range: A short range skill that heals yourself. Description: Command your companion to cast a protective ward. Heals you and applies Borrowed Wings, increasing your Dodge by 20% for 6 seconds. Follow Up: Applies Eye in the Sky, increasing your Dodge by 40% for 6 seconds. When cast out of combat will summon a Grifflet if you don't have a pet equipped. Notes: Pet is Grifflet. Pet cannot be summoned in PVP if it's not summoned before entering Arenas.
